feedback.lib-atlas: I don't like how overly wordy it is, tons of over-explaining AI spam. I like the idea behind the panel/ and then kinship stuff, it's very cool, but this all would be hidden/a layover popup or something in the final design, not the first thing you see on the page. Save it.
feedback.lib-herbarium: I don't see anything here I like, at all; it feels aweful.
feedback.lib-seedbank: it's clean, it gives me real stats and why, I like the germinating; I love that trace a claim is easy to see, but I think it would be better to be "ask AI" or something like that but better put, with real intelligence behind the search; this all needs to be a panel on library, not the main page, other than maybe the stats
feedback.lib-null: it's clean, has easy to read stats, what it's read (the point of the page), signals are helpful; it's all easy to ingest at a glance; it should be the main library page with sub-sections for stuff atlas/seed bank
feedback.lib-overall: it should be like a seasoned investor looking at the stock market ticket or the wsj and they give  simple "hmm, good" head nod
feedback.eng-watchlog: it's just an absolute mess nothing redeeming here
feedback.eng-null: clean layout but too much word spam; I like the day's ledger a lot
feedback.eng-checklist: I'm not really seeing anything great here, it doesn't tell me much, no story
feedback.eng-nightlog: the plan for today works, the rest is meh
feedback.eng-timetable: this looks very cool, it's a great idea borrowing from history (train stations) and banking on "engine room;" it's a start, this is not it, but I like the idea...
feedback.eng-overall: the engine room are where the technicals live, where someone can go and see "omg, there's real engineering beneath all of this, it isn't just a website, it's  a well-oiled, well thought out, intentional 200K lines of code doing real things and I can see exactly what and why and how and how they all interoperate like a scada system

feedback.l3-hybrid: it's clean, a nice ask bar to solve "how to discover amongst 10K's of things" but there's not a lot of info, which can be ok as the first thing a user sees
feedback.l3-ticker: love the density, it's ok-ish... I might even choose it but I won't
feedback.l3-terminal: I like the sections, it's a bit cleaner while being info-dense, but I'm not sure each section earns the order... is holdings the right word, what does  sweep tell a person just stepping into the system, etc.
feedback.l3-broadsheet: this is great, love the header and to the ask bar BUT it's too wordy, but I like the style... the overnight readings might be great, I like how it shows multiple sections, market signals is cool but might need to be its own page and nothing to do with library
feedback.l3-paneldock: ah yes, a dock is the way! this is the winner so far all-around
feedback.l3-askfirst: ohhh... this plus the panel dock might be the way, minus market signals as that really has no relation to library
feedback.l3-overall: overall we need to remove market signals and that reminds me of other main sections in the header that might be missing... should market/signals be it's own area as it's more in line with portfolio/commercialization (e.g. where do those sections live), we need the simulation section, etc. we'll need do discuss all this

feedback.l4-askhero: the very obvious winner here, not loving the panels section unless it can collapse to a right-side tab that expands in and out

feedback.e3-oneline: I think it's difficult to say anything too negative about this, some wordy-spam but overall very good. Just needs tones of refinement.
feedback.e3-blueprint: I really like the idea of the schematic, maybe the train line + schematic is worth trying, staying closer to train line. This gets a bit much, and the rest is junk (the sheets).
feedback.e3-timetable2: By far the cleanest, a real contender it's 50/50 against the train line version.

feedback.e5-L3: no this is word spam x 100
feedback.e5-L4: boring but the cards do work
feedback.e5-L5: the metro map is interesting I'd like to see other versions but this is word spam again, use as few words as possible to convey meaning, don't try to sound smart, be smart
feedback.e5-T1: clean... but does it really tell us a data story?
feedback.e5-T3: it's trying but it's just not correct
feedback.e5-T5: I  just don't see the data story
feedback.e5-B1: this is getting better and telling a data story but it's still off, it's not coherent, it's schizo
feedback.e5-overall: don't try to sound smart, be smart, don't be schizo, be coherent; a fresh round without feeling like your failing, just with new clearer direction

feedback.e6-M4: this is compelling because it's unique but is the volume-flow true will it actually show the real size and different every moment based on real flow; what does scale break mean?
feedback.e6-MC1: I don't mind the cards but I don't think it makes sense how it's layed with the line as the lines going up from the cards are meaningless and actually ill if taken literally
feedback.e6-D1: this is very compelling, especially if everything is clickable/drillable where clicking a run spot on the calendar changes every other widget to reflect, and even shows which articles ingested and other fine details, if this give us real operator drilldown, it's the winner; dream bigger on this one while keeping it clean

feedback.e7-E3: this is the winner, lock it in
